rows.grounds: libation formula addressed to Narada; mantra material kept as given
iti+ādi+krama; instrumental expressing manner or sequence

items.question: By what sequential procedure is the Narada libation formula applied?
premises: The formula states satisfaction offered to Narada.
The expression indicates a sequence of such formulas.
The verse identifies this as the ritual application.
items.inference: The Narada libation formula is applied as part of a prescribed sequence of similar offerings.
uncertainties: The full list of recipients implied by ityādi is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Saying 'Om, I satisfy Narada,' and so on in sequence, is the application.
